text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after sparring with 
Phalaenopsis 
at the dojo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We found ourselves visiting the training 
club once again.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Forgive me, but... 
I have returned to this place several 
times already.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I searched for answers here. 
Even so... I still...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As a trailblazer for this club... I could 
not bring 
myself to believe that I was worthy.
choice_data_list:
Don't rush. Let's try looking for it 
together this time.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Miss Phalaeno! Long time no see! 
—Look, it's the Miss Phalaeno you admire 
so much! 
Make sure you say hello, okay?

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... H-Hello...! 
Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
You looked so cool in the Milers Cup! 
...P-Please do your best in your next race 
too!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... thank you for your support. 
You, too, must keep striving.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, ma'am! I-I'll give it my all too... 
so I can be just like you, Miss Phalaeno!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
“Hyaaaaahhh!!!” 
“Hah!!!” 
“Hyaaaaaahhhh!”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......The young fillies of this club 
are all... so remarkably earnest.
choice_data_list: Yeah, they really are.
Yeah, they sure are.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Was this what you wished to show me? 
Though, it is quite the usual sight...
choice_data_list:
No, it's more like... what comes after, 
I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: What comes after...?

text_block_list.name: Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
All right, that wraps it up for today! 
Good work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
“Thank you for your hard work!” “Thanks, 
Coach!” 
“Good work, everyone!”

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Coach! Um, would it be all right if I 
did... 
some extra training today, too?

text_block_list.name: Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, let me see your face... —All 
right, go ahead! 
Just make sure to report how much you ran 
afterwards! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! 
Well then, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...That is rather intense. 
Though, I do understand how she feels.
choice_data_list:
(...Maybe that girl can help her truly 
feel it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I make a suggestion to Phalaenopsis, who 
seemed to share that sentiment. 
“If you wouldn't mind, why not—”
choice_data_list: join her for her extra training?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...? 
I do not mind doing so, but...
choice_data_list: All right, then it's decided!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since that girl usually goes on long 
roadwork sessions, 
I decided to head to the finish line ahead 
of time 
so as not to get in their way.
choice_data_list: Well then, see you after your training!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Huff, huff... huff, huff... 
Tell me if the pace is too quick. I shall 
ease up.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... N-No, I'm okay! 
I-I'll keep up with you, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... By the way, 
is this the right direction for our route?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Just up ahead is—

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah... Whew. 
I ran the whole way...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...To run such a distance right after 
finishing 
your training at the club... well done.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
...E-Ehehe. 
...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, why make Tracen Academy your 
destination? 
Would it not be far easier to set your 
goal 
somewhere closer?

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's... well, because it's what I 
long for... 
I guess I just can't help coming to look 
at it...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
I-I... seeing you run, Miss Phaleno... 
That was what made me want to enter Tracen 
Academy. 
That's really what made up my mind...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
...I used to be a washout, to be honest. 
So I was wondering if maybe there was 
another path 
for me besides racing, but―

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: ―you set my heart ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
You were so amazing... really! So cool! 
When I heard you had health issues and 
couldn't run 
properly for a while—I couldn't believe it 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
And as I kept watching you, Miss 
Phaleno... 
I finally realized.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
The club that sent you out into the world 
gives every horsegirl a chance. 
It will make you strong as long as you 
work for it.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Because right now, at this very moment―

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: You're proving that out on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
And that's why... wait, waah!? 
I-I'm so, so sorry for babbling on and 
on!!

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
To sum it up, I just looked up to you, 
Miss Phaleno, 
joined the club, and set my sights on 
Tracen Academy! 
That's all it is, yes! I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
............No, think nothing of it. 
There is no need to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You were right.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The other day, you spoke true. 
That Phalaenopsis is the club's very 
"hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...It was the truth.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Because I was... none other than 
Phalaenopsis―

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: She came knocking upon the club's gates.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's right.
Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not Special Week. 
Nor Narita Brian. The one who spurred her 
toward 
the club was―Phalaenopsis.
choice_data_list:
Your "way of life" is what lit a fire in 
her.

Your "way of life" is what lit that fire 
in her.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
Do you still think there's no future at 
the end of this road?

Do you still believe there's no future 
down this road?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To this day, she had run with all her 
might to repay 
her debt to the club. Truly, truly, with 
all her heart.
choice_data_list:
At times, with a fierce intensity that 
wrung the hearts of all who watched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way her running, her efforts, 
her results 
―would ever fail to reach someone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way her journey, her 
hoofprints, her story 
―would fail to become someone's dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So she never had any reason to agonize 
over it. 
I wanted her to take genuine pride in 
herself, 
in Phalaenopsis, shining bright as the 
club's trailblazer.
choice_data_list:
You haven't gone wrong at all, I'm sure of 
it.

I know you haven't made a single wrong 
turn.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How should Phalaenopsis carry herself in 
the face of the fervor 
stirred up by the Classic route runners? 
This was my answer to that question.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: …So, I was not mistaken after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then—all I must do is continue as I have.
choice_data_list: …Yeah, that's right.
…Yes, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Blinded by the dazzling light of Spe and 
the others' rapid ascent… 
I had lost sight of myself. But now… I 
see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I had convinced myself that who I was fell 
short. 
Yet that… was merely an assumption on my 
part.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes… there is only one thing I must do.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To take what I have done up until now, 
and do it “even more fiercely than 
before.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that, the future I wish to attain 
“does” exist.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(…It feels as though I were a young child, 
being gently led by the hand.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The path that had faded from my view, 
that I had completely lost sight of… and 
yet—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —It was you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I thank you for your guidance. 
Truly, thank you…
choice_data_list: You're welcome. …Though,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After accepting her gratitude, I quietly 
shake my head. 
In truth, there was no need for such 
thanks.
choice_data_list:
I only did what any Trainer naturally 
would.

I just did what any Trainer would do, 
that's all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
…Heh. Is that so? 
Even if that were true, however—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
that was no reason for me to leave it 
unsaid.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
…On my own, I never could have found 
the certainty of this path.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I was saved by your keen insight.
choice_data_list: …I just happened to know, that's all.
…Well, I just knew, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All she had to do was show her “way of 
life.” 
I knew that alone would lead to a 
flourishing future for the club. 
Because—
choice_data_list:
Long before that girl, I was the one 
captivated by you.

Long before that girl, I was the one who 
looked up to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After all, having been so inspired by her 
way of being… 
a Trainer, of all people, had gone so far 
as to ask to become an Umamusume's 
“apprentice.”
choice_data_list:
That's just how brilliantly your “way of 
life” shines.

That's just how brightly your “way of 
life” shines.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And because of that… I realized how 
wonderful the club was 
for giving her the ability to run in the 
first place. 
—I knew she could make everyone else 
understand that, too.
choice_data_list:
That's why I felt “staying true to who you 
are” was right.

That's why I knew “staying true to who you 
are” was right.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
…Ahaha! I see, I see! 
The very first to admire me… That was you!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. So from the very beginning… 
you have been utterly enchanted by me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what an endearing one you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fog seemed to have cleared from 
Phalaenopsis's mind. 
At this rate, surely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. I sat down with Phalaenopsis 
once again to discuss her next race.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, the path before me is 
clear. I shall continue 
to cross swords upon the “Tiara” route.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
…Though I took a detour, in the end, 
here is where my hoofprints are meant to 
be etched.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—In the “Tiara,” no matter the era, no 
matter 
the circumstance, I shall become an 
unrivaled bloom.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And by blooming in such full glory, 
I shall make our Club “the most beautiful 
garden of all.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Does that meet with your approval, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course!
Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then my next race will be the Victoria 
Mile. 
Followed by the Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup—aiming 
for every tiara within reach in the Senior 
Class.
choice_data_list:
And the one displaying her strength there 
right now is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah… Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro Dober. 
Much like Phalaenopsis, she has proven her 
mettle 
along the Tiara route—the ultimate 
predecessor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I won't go back to those pathetic days. 
From now on, I... even someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become it. 
The ideal that I've always looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During Phalaenopsis's Junior year, she 
achieved 
the Double Tiara by winning the Oaks and 
the Shuka Sho, 
distinguishing herself as a premier Tiara 
horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next year, she clashed with Air Groove 
in the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup. Going toe-to-toe with 
the likes of Special Week, 
the "Empress" was deemed the strongest in 
the Tiara division—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—and Dober defeated her. Pulling the 
"Empress" from 
her throne, she established herself as the 
undisputed 
queen of the contemporary Tiara route.
choice_data_list:
And she is the one we're going to 
challenge.

And she is the one we're going to 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Needless to say, 
she will not be an easy opponent.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. So for now, let's focus on what's 
right in front of us.

Yeah. So for now, let's focus on what's 
right in front of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If all goes as planned, our clash with 
Mejiro Dober 
will come in late autumn—at the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So for now, I shall focus on my next 
race—the Victoria Mile... 
and make claiming the throne of the Tiara 
Queen from her 
our overarching goal down the road.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to seeing you become 
the one true queen.

I'm looking forward to seeing you become 
the one true queen.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Indeed. 
Expect great things from me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next race, the Victoria Mile— 
—she will not lose.
